name: Rogue Soul 2 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Rogue Soul 2 features more levels to run, jump, slide, dodge, and fight your way through. With its expanded levels, dynamic gameplay, upgrade system, challenging enemies, secrets and collectibles, and competitive features, Rogue Soul 2 offers an action-packed side-scrolling adventure that will keep you entertained for hours on end.
